in_sanskrit.name: Intika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rare flower
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Intika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Intika is a rare and beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Inta' meaning 'rare' and 'Ka' meaning 'flower'. This name symbolizes the rarity and uniqueness of the flower of life, often associated with the goddess of love and beauty, Parvati.
